column1: # The upstream CRDs the chart's schemas are generated from (scripts/ci/kube_schemas.py; `make crd-schemas`).
# One place for their versions. Columns (tab-separated): name  version  url  sha256  kinds (comma-separated).
# A pin is the newest stable release published at least 7 days before it was pinned (pinned 2026-11-22).
# The sha256 of a GitHub release asset is its release digest; a file at a tag is hashed on download, and a
# changed file is refused. Every served version of each listed kind is generated.
